question: What is the luminous aspect present within differentiated manifestation?
premises: Within the differentiated part there is an aspect of manifestation.
As the form of being, it animates all appearances.
inference: Even within differentiation there remains a self-luminous aspect whose nature is to animate all manifestation.
plain_english: In that part there is this aspect of manifestation, self-luminous in the form of being; that is the very nature which animates all things.
